title: Create a contact
intent: Create exactly one contact from a user-supplied name and email, after checking for a duplicate and receiving explicit confirmation.
instructions: Call list_contacts first when it helps establish what already exists; the write re-checks anyway, but a needless proposal wastes the user's attention.
Call create_contact with the exact name and email the user supplied. Do not invent an email, and do not tidy a name into something the user did not say.

The server normalizes the proposal, checks for a duplicate over a complete read, shows the exact effect and targets for confirmation, executes at most once, and reads the record back under the same actor.
After a successful result, open only the returned ui_path and observe the page before finishing.
If confirmation is denied, stop and say so. If the outcome is uncertain, stop and say that instead; never retry the write.
